title: Add compact hooks, progress events, keepalive, and cleanup lifecycle
objective: Make Go compaction participate in the same lifecycle as TS: pre/post hooks, progress status, session-start hooks, cache notifications, and cleanup.
implementation_scope: Run PreCompact hooks with trigger and custom instructions where Go has hook support.
Merge hook-provided custom instructions with user-provided compact instructions.
Run session-start hooks after successful compaction and include their messages as hookResults.
Run PostCompact hooks with trigger and compact summary.
Expose compact progress events and SDK/UI compacting status.
Send keepalive/status refresh during long compaction if Go has remote sessions or SDK streams.
Implement RunPostCompactCleanup to reset microcompact state, cache-break baselines, memory/system-prompt caches, speculative approval state, and session message caches where present.
Notify prompt cache break detector after compaction.
out_of_scope: Do not build a new hook framework if Go has no hook infrastructure; add narrow interfaces and no-op implementations.
Do not implement telemetry metrics beyond lifecycle events; task_19 owns metrics parity.
acceptance_criteria: Manual and automatic compaction both run the shared cleanup path.
Hook user display text is preserved in CompactionResult.
Compaction status is cleared in a finally/defer path on success, failure, or cancellation.
Tests cover hook instruction merge, hook failure/cancellation behavior, and cleanup invocation.
risks: Shared module-level cleanup must not corrupt main-thread state when subagents compact.
Hook execution order needs to match TS to avoid subtle behavior drift.
dispatch_prompt: Add TS-like compaction lifecycle behavior in Go: hooks, progress/status, keepalive, cache notifications, and centralized post-compact cleanup.
